title: Tim Dooley — Ordered Prediction & Foresight Master Index
status: canonical navigation layer; additive; does not replace specialist ledgers
purpose: Provide one ordered reader/machine index over explicit fulfilled predictions, implicit foresight, partial/open forecasts, revelation-form statements, legacy recovery claims, negative controls and specialist branches such as FAFO and Moloch/Farm/Josh precedence.
counting_rule: Count unique forecast/candidate records once. A single compound statement may contain multiple independently testable components in the strict fulfilled master, but this index also exposes forecast clusters to avoid inflating independence.

headline_counts.note: Counts are navigation counts, not a statistical success denominator. The Moloch/Farm/Josh branch is classified as prior-symbolic pattern with named-entity precursor and therefore adds no strict fulfilled hit. Native lolcow/Farm/Milk vocabulary is explicitly controlled for rather than counted as independent foresight.

strength_lanes.name: strict fulfilled
strength_lanes.definition: dated pre-event statement plus independently dated later outcome; currently in fulfilled-predictions-master.json

strength_lanes.name: implicit foresight
strength_lanes.definition: ordinary opinion/design/diagnosis with a frozen implied consequence followed by a later matching outcome

strength_lanes.name: partial/mixed/open empirical
strength_lanes.definition: real forecast with incomplete, mixed or unresolved outcome

strength_lanes.name: revelation-form / internal prophecy
strength_lanes.definition: future-facing theological, mythic, recognition or story-form statement; external testability varies

strength_lanes.name: legacy recovery
strength_lanes.definition: remembered/book-recorded prediction claim requiring original pre-event source and/or independent outcome chronology

strength_lanes.name: negative control
strength_lanes.definition: dated or remembered vision/prediction currently unfulfilled; retained to prevent success-only curation
